asu.title: Firmware upgrade
asu.help: Upgrade to a newer OpenWrt release and keep the installed packages: the OpenWrt build service makes an image for this router, which is then downloaded, verified and installed with the settings kept. NuCI is carried across.
asu.no_newer: OpenWrt {version} is the newest build of this release.
asu.missing: Not available in the new release: {packages}
asu.accept_warnings: I have read the warnings above and want to continue.
asu.server_help: The router sends its model and package list here to get an image built.
asu.confirm_text: The router writes the new firmware and restarts with its settings kept. This takes a few minutes; do not switch it off. The page reloads when the router is back.
asu.phase.restarting: The router is restarting with the new firmware…
asu.phase.timeout: The router did not come back. Check it and reload this page.
